Part 4 – 90 minutes

::: notes
Last part. You spent the end of Part 3 trying specifications and watching the estimate move. Now we give that activity its proper name and read it as a chart: every justifiable analysis of this claim on these data, with the five analysts and the original result placed on it. Then we leave the original data behind and look at the new audit that SCORE ran to test the claim again, and at what it means that the two disagree. And then you settle on one analysis, preregister it before you run it, and submit it to the class chart.
